description: Four CV inputs written onto four consecutive channels of the DMX universe a DMX Hub is sending, one lighting fixture per module

params.text: Scales that channel's CV before it becomes a DMX level, 0 to 1, and comes up at 1
Holds that channel at DMX 0 while it is on
Holds every channel on this fixture and on every fixture to its right at DMX 0, and dims their mute lamps while it is on
Passes this fixture's four incoming voltages on to the fixtures to its right, for any of their channels with no cable patched; it comes up off
Scales every channel on this fixture, 0 to 1, and comes up at 1; what reaches the fixtures to the right is the incoming voltage before this knob, despite its tooltip calling it chain-wide

inputs.text: The level for that DMX channel, 0V to 10V and clamped to that, mapped onto the full DMX range

notes: a DMX Fixture does nothing without a DMX Hub somewhere to its left in an unbroken row of modules
the module claims four consecutive DMX channels, counted from the Hub's start channel and its own place in the row, unless a fixed address is set from the menu
the coloured swatch on the panel shows what the fixture is being told to do, read through whichever profile is chosen
menu: Fixture Profile: PAR (DIM), WASH, SPOT, STROBE, PAR (RGB), RGBW, CUSTOM — relabels the four channels and tells the swatch how to read them; four channels go out whichever is chosen
DMX Address: Auto (use Hub's chain position), Override to... — sets whether the first of the four channels follows the Hub and this module's place in the row, or a number you type

unpatched it reads the same channel on the fixture to its left; a negative voltage does nothing here.
